derived_features.construction: Filter raw edges by causes qualification and any of the three sources, group by canonical endpoint pair, count distinct raw relationship identities, and merge one compact relationship per pair. Missing qualifiers or source arrays do not qualify. The rule uses only presence, then rematches raw edges with its recorded exact predicates, qualifiers, and sources. Removing the initial access-path MATCH and WITH before the marked comment gives the otherwise identical unmaterialized query.
derived_features.definition: A stored Drug-to-GeneOrGeneProduct relationship exists for a causes-qualified member of the full affects descendant closure with ChEMBL, Guide to Pharmacology, or DrugCentral primary-source support.
derived_features.formula: compact presence iff count(distinct qualifying raw relationship)>0
inputs: The full pinned affects descendant closure on Drug-to-GeneOrGeneProduct edges

Store both lists and their summed length in one relationship. Parallel source edges do not multiply support; a gene with both signs appears in both lists. execution.cypher:
MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[direct:AFFECTS]->(disease:Disease)
WHERE direct.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"]
WITH chemical,collect(DISTINCT disease) AS diseases
CALL (chemical,diseases) {
  MATCH (chemical)-[target:AFFECTS]->(regulator:GeneOrGeneProduct)
  WHERE target.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"]
    AND target.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'
    AND target.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased']
    AND target.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']
  WITH DISTINCT regulator,target.object_direction_qualifier AS drug_direction,diseases
  MATCH (regulator)-[context:MINER_R0004_SIGNED_CAUSAL_CONTEXT]->(disease:Disease)
  WHERE context.artifact_id='r0004-signed-regulator-causal-context-v1'
    AND context.run_id='run-2026-08-21-0915'
    AND disease IN diseases
  WITH regulator,disease,drug_direction,
    CASE WHEN drug_direction='increased' THEN context.decreased_gene_element_ids
         ELSE context.increased_gene_element_ids END AS downstream_gene_ids
  UNWIND downstream_gene_ids AS downstream_gene_id
  MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)
  WHERE elementId(gene)=downstream_gene_id
  MATCH (regulator)-[bridge:AFFECTS]->(gene)
  WHERE bridge.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"]
    AND bridge.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'
    AND bridge.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased']
    AND bridge.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']
    AND regulator<>gene
    AND drug_direction<>bridge.object_direction_qualifier
  MATCH (gene)-[causal:CAUSES|CONTRIBUTES_TO]->(disease)
  WHERE causal.predicate IN ["biolink:causes","biolink:contributes_to"]
  RETURN disease,count(DISTINCT gene) AS support_count
}
RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,support_count

execution.cypher:
MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[direct:AFFECTS]->(disease:Disease)
WHERE direct.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"]
WITH chemical,collect(DISTINCT disease) AS diseases
CALL (chemical,diseases) {
  MATCH (chemical)-[target:AFFECTS]->(regulator:GeneOrGeneProduct)
  WHERE target.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"]
    AND target.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'
    AND target.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased']
    AND target.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']
  WITH DISTINCT regulator,diseases
  MATCH (regulator)-[context:MINER_R0004_SIGNED_CAUSAL_CONTEXT]->(disease:Disease)
  WHERE context.artifact_id='r0004-signed-regulator-causal-context-v1'
    AND context.run_id='run-2026-08-21-0915'
    AND disease IN diseases
  WITH regulator,disease,
    context.increased_gene_element_ids + context.decreased_gene_element_ids AS downstream_gene_ids
  UNWIND downstream_gene_ids AS downstream_gene_id
  WITH DISTINCT regulator,disease,downstream_gene_id
  MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)
  WHERE elementId(gene)=downstream_gene_id
  MATCH (regulator)-[bridge:AFFECTS]->(gene)
  WHERE bridge.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"]
    AND bridge.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'
    AND bridge.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased']
    AND bridge.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']
    AND regulator<>gene
  MATCH (gene)-[causal:CAUSES|CONTRIBUTES_TO]->(disease)
  WHERE causal.predicate IN ["biolink:causes","biolink:contributes_to"]
  RETURN disease,count(DISTINCT gene) AS support_count
}
RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,support_count

WITH chemical,collect(DISTINCT disease) AS diseases
CALL (chemical,diseases) {
  MATCH (chemical)-[target:AFFECTS|AFFECTS_RESPONSE_TO|AMELIORATES_CONDITION|DECREASES_RESPONSE_TO|DISRUPTS|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|HAS_ADVERSE_EVENT|HAS_SIDE_EFFECT|INCREASES_RESPONSE_TO|REGULATES]->(regulator:GeneOrGeneProduct)
  WHERE target.predicate IN ["biolink:affects","biolink:affects_response_to","biolink:ameliorates_condition","biolink:decreases_response_to","biolink:disrupts","biolink:exacerbates_condition","biolink:has_adverse_event","biolink:has_side_effect","biolink:increases_response_to","biolink:regulates"]
    AND target.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'
    AND target.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased']
    AND target.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']
  WITH DISTINCT regulator,diseases
  MATCH (regulator)-[context:MINER_R0004_SIGNED_CAUSAL_CONTEXT]->(disease:Disease)
  WHERE context.artifact_id='r0004-signed-regulator-causal-context-v1'
    AND context.run_id='run-2026-08-21-0915'
    AND disease IN diseases
  WITH regulator,disease,

  WITH DISTINCT regulator,disease,downstream_gene_id

    AND bridge.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'
    AND bridge.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased']
    AND bridge.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']
    AND regulator<>gene
  MATCH (gene)-[causal:CAUSES|CONTRIBUTES_TO]->(disease)
  WHERE causal.predicate IN ["biolink:causes","biolink:contributes_to"]
  RETURN disease,count(DISTINCT gene) AS support_count
}

execution.cypher: MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[target:AFFECTS|AFFECTS_RESPONSE_TO|AMELIORATES_CONDITION|DECREASES_RESPONSE_TO|DISRUPTS|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|HAS_ADVERSE_EVENT|HAS_SIDE_EFFECT|INCREASES_RESPONSE_TO|REGULATES]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct) WHERE target.predicate IN ["biolink:affects","biolink:affects_response_to","biolink:ameliorates_condition","biolink:decreases_response_to","biolink:disrupts","biolink:exacerbates_condition","biolink:has_adverse_event","biolink:has_side_effect","biolink:increases_response_to","biolink:regulates"] AND target.qualified_predicate = "biolink:causes" AND target.object_direction_qualifier = "decreased" AND target.object_aspect_qualifier IN ["activity","activity_or_abundance"] AND any(source IN ["infores:chembl","infores:gtopdb","infores:drugcentral"] WHERE source IN coalesce(target.primary_knowledge_sources,[])) WITH gene,collect(DISTINCT chemical) AS chemicals UNWIND coalesce(gene.in_taxon,[])+CASE WHEN gene.taxon IS NULL THEN [] ELSE [gene.taxon] END AS taxon WITH taxon,collect(DISTINCT {gene:gene,chemicals:chemicals}) AS target_groups MATCH (organism:OrganismTaxon) WHERE taxon IN [organism.id]+coalesce(organism.equivalent_identifiers,[]) MATCH (organism:OrganismTaxon)-[infection:CAUSES]->(disease:Disease) WHERE infection.predicate IN ["biolink:causes"] UNWIND target_groups AS target_group UNWIND target_group.chemicals AS chemical WITH chemical,target_group.gene AS gene,organism,disease MATCH (organism:OrganismTaxon)-[organism_product:PRODUCES]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct) WHERE organism_product.predicate IN ["biolink:produces"] RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,count(DISTINCT organism) AS support_count
